name: Optimization Techniques in Water Resources
description: Optimization techniques and stakeholders’ viewpoints in water resources planning and management, and in engineering design, operation and development of water resources projects involving water supply, irrigation, hydropower, flood control, and water conservation projects; linear programming and duality, network flow algorithms, dynamic programming, nonlinear programming, introduction to emerging optimization techniques; multiobjective optimization, trade-offs and non-inferior solutions, conflict resolution; incorporating uncertainty, randomness and vagueness; applications to reservoir operation, groundwater management, conjunctive water management, pollution control, and agricultural water management to ensure sustainability and develop climate resilient and adaptive strategies and policies; case studies in other disciplines - agriculture, environment, transportation, construction, etc.
